name: Award of Merit Scholarship for Agricultural Engineering Students (B.Tech 3rd/4th Year)
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 3rd or 4th year of the B.Tech (Agricultural Engineering) course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.
